body.says: Every word the field says, in lower case, each once, where it is first said: worked out from the words each time, never kept beside them.
Any holon nothing closer draws: what it is an instance of, and every value it holds, each reference a slot offered a face; as a face, its name and types.
A session read as it was had: its day and what was kept of it, what was said in order, each utterance in its own words by whose voice, and the paths it noted.
A brief: in full, the way down to it, its name and flow, and its sections read through after it; as a face, its name and first paragraph.
One utterance: its place, how it came and whose voice, and its own words; seen from above, its first words.
One thread: what it asks and where it stands, and whether it waits on the author; in full, the sentences it was raised in.
